title: Use of Faecal Calprotectin to Predict Enteropathy of the Preterm Neonates
brief_summary: This study aims to evaluate a clinico-biological predictive score, associating the faecal calprotectin, for the diagnosis of enterocolitis and enteropathy of the preterm neonates.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Infants prematurely born at a gestational age of 33 weeks or less (or before the 7th month of pregnancy).
* Patient whose parents or holders of parental authority signed an informed consent.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patient with a malformation.
* Lack of signature of the consent by parents or holders of parental authority.
